name: park-ops
description: ParkOps monorepo — NestJS backend + Next.js frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait && for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do pnpm db:migrate && break || sleep 2; done
